title: Volcanoes of El Salvador
intro: 10 volcanoes of El Salvador, one after another. Put your marker as near as you can; the nearer, the more points. The map shows coasts, rivers, lakes and borders, and you work inside this area.

rounds.name: San Salvador
rounds.fact: San Salvador is a stratovolcano; the latest significant eruption recorded for it in the source data was in 1917. The data places it in El Salvador.
